items.source: Marker interface for configuration classes related to Redis connection setup. As the setup scenarios are quite diverse instead of struggling with unifying those, RedisConfiguration provides means to identify configurations for the individual purposes.
items.translation: 与 Redis 连接设置相关的配置类的标记接口。由于设置场景非常多样化，而不是试图统一它们，RedisConfiguration 提供了识别特定用途配置的手段。

items.source: RedisConfiguration part suitable for configurations that use a specific database.
items.translation: 适用于使用特定数据库的 RedisConfiguration 部分。

items.source: RedisConfiguration part suitable for configurations that use native domain sockets for connecting.
items.translation: 适用于使用原生域套接字进行连接的 RedisConfiguration 部分。

items.source: RedisConfiguration part suitable for configurations that use host/port combinations for connecting.
items.translation: 适用于使用主机/端口组合进行连接的 RedisConfiguration 部分。

items.source: Configuration interface suitable for Redis cluster environments.
items.translation: 适用于 Redis 集群环境的配置界面。

items.source: Configuration interface suitable for single node redis connections using local unix domain socket.
items.translation: 适用于使用本地 Unix 域套接字连接单个节点 Redis 的配置界面。

items.source: Configuration interface suitable for Redis Sentinel environments.
items.translation: 适用于 Redis Sentinel 环境的配置界面。

items.source: Configuration interface suitable for Redis master/replica environments with fixed hosts.
items.translation: 适用于固定主从节点的 Redis 主从环境配置界面。
